product.summary: Tonkeeper non-custodial mobile wallet application for TON and supported assets/services.
product.notes: Current first-party privacy material identifies Tonkeeper's App Store/Google Play application and dates the privacy policy to 2021; Tonkeeper also states it was founded in 2021. Year precision only.

events.title: Tonkeeper Android 26.05.1 released
events.description: The official Tonkeeper Android repository published release 26.05.1 on 2026-05-18 with packaged Android assets, providing dated first-party evidence of continuing maintenance of the mobile wallet.

events.title: Tonkeeper W5 wallet standard was finalized with TON Core
events.description: Tonkeeper documents that the W5 wallet standard, designed for gasless transactions and extensibility, was finalized together with the TON Core team in July 2024. Tonkeeper subsequently used W5 for Battery and gasless transaction flows.

evidence.title: Tonkeeper Signer
evidence.notes: Current first-party Tonkeeper page describes Tonkeeper as the non-custodial TON wallet and states it was founded in 2021; used only for year-level lineage.

evidence.title: Tonkeeper Android 26.05.1
evidence.notes: Official Tonkeeper Android GitHub release published 2026-05-18.

evidence.title: How Tonkeeper Brings Gasless Transactions to TON
evidence.notes: First-party Tonkeeper technical article states that Tonkeeper and TON Core finalized the W5 standard in July 2024 and explains Battery and gasless transaction support.
